Tropical Weather Outlook
NWS National Hurricane Center Miami FL
700 PM EST Sat Nov 7 2026

For the North Atlantic...Caribbean Sea and the Gulf of America:

Western and Central Atlantic (AL94):
A broad, non-tropical low pressure system located several hundred 
miles south-southeast of Bermuda is producing disorganized showers 
and thunderstorms to the east of its center. The system remains in 
close proximity to fronts, and recent satellite images indicate the 
circulation of the low has become less defined today. Subtropical 
development of this system is not expected while it moves generally 
eastward and merges with a frontal system over the next day or two. 
For more information, including Gale Warnings, see High Seas 
Forecasts issued by the National Weather Service.
* Formation chance through 48 hours...low...near 0 percent.
* Formation chance through 7 days...low...near 0 percent.
